# Every use of `unsafe` outside comments in every Rust file in the repository, counted as uses,
# not lines, by file. CI counts them on every change and fails when the counts differ from this
# list, so new `unsafe` can't land without someone updating this file in the same pull request,
# where review sees it. Each is explained where it is; the two in the self-host tests are the
# word in test programs, and the one in the lexer is the word in its list of reserved words.
